metadata.title: Virtualization Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing secure, isolated, and trustworthy execution of multiple workloads on shared physical computing platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Virtualized compute platforms, hypervisor-managed infrastructure, and shared host execution environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes isolation, trust boundaries, and safe multi-tenant operation on hypervisor-mediated platforms.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Virtualization trust assumes an explicitly trusted physical host substrate.

metadata.remarks: Virtualization Core defines the foundational trust properties required to safely operate multiple workloads on a shared physical host using a hypervisor. This pattern makes guest isolation, host–guest boundaries, and virtualization-layer attack surface explicit, without asserting hypervisor-specific control ownership.

components.title: Virtual Machine Isolation
components.description: Prevents unauthorized interaction or interference between co-resident virtual machines.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement through shared host services or misconfigured inter-VM communication paths.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation of execution contexts across virtual machines.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow control between VM execution domains.

components.title: Host–Guest Trust Boundary
components.description: Maintains strict separation between guest workloads and the host or hypervisor execution context.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation via guest-to-host or guest-to-hypervisor exploitation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Enforcement of separation between guest and host privilege domains.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity protection of host and hypervisor execution state.
Least functionality exposed from host to guest workloads.

components.title: Lateral Movement Containment
components.description: Limits the ability of a compromised guest to move laterally across shared virtual infrastructure.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Remote service abuse enabling cross-VM lateral movement.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logical segmentation and restriction of inter-VM communication paths.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Containment of east–west traffic within virtualized hosts.
Identification of exploitable lateral movement paths.
